title: agentdag approve payload
description: The typed suspend payload an approve node writes before the coordinator process EXITS (design 3.4). A decision is one of this payload's options[].id values - that id IS the decision value the journal records (C4). The decision itself arrives as decisions/<node_id>.json, written temp+rename by the CLI or the server, and the coordinator folds it into the journal on relaunch.

text.description: What is being decided, in plain text for a human reviewer.

node_id.description: The approve node this payload belongs to.

artefact_refs.description: Artefact references to review before deciding.

id.description: The option's stable identifier. It IS the value a decision carries: run.approve's `decision` and the approve_decision journal line record exactly this string (design 3.4, C4).

effect.description: Whether choosing this option causes an EXTERNAL side effect (a push, a publish, a mail). Validation refuses a payload whose `default` names an option with effect 'external', because the default is applied unattended by the deadline owner (design 2.4, 3.4); and a gate offering any external option needs a human identity distinct from the run's starter (O21).

options.description: The choices offered to the reviewer.

default.description: The option id applied if no decision arrives by decide_by. The SERVER or a timer unit applies it and journals `by: system, reason: deadline` - the coordinator process has exited and cannot (design 3.4, O18/M21). Must name an option whose effect is 'none'.

decide_by.description: ISO-8601 UTC deadline for the decision, with an explicit +00:00 offset (design 3.3).

workflow.description: Name of the workflow this run executes.

run_id.description: The run this approve payload belongs to.

examples.text: Publish release v2.3.0 to PyPI and tag the repo?
